notes.title: Final Version
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce the final release version of Magnet Mania 3D!

It has all main features we planned to make in early access with your help ! Of course we will keep updating and advancing it even after full release but core functionality of the Magnet Mania simulator is built. Based on user feedback we received.  

- Sandbox mode Import 3d objects and change their materials!
- Advanced objects in Sandbox mode
- All new Scenes look for all levels
- Mode details and fine tunes
- 25+ levels 
- Sandbox Objectives mode

notes.title: First game update!
notes.notes:
Hello big and small engineers ! Thank you so much for your support and contribution to make this project a great success!

Here is our first update based on your feedback. 

Visual and gameplay improvements based on users feedback. Feature updates.

- Bug fixes, visual improvements
- Menu options for all hardware resolutions
- Procedural magnet visualization
- Music, sound effects improvements
- Some Levels are restricted in this version as they are getting rebuilt.

- Adding features you requested!
